entities.summary: Marco Insam is an Italian professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing for Italian club, Ritten/Renon of the Alps Hockey League (AlpsHL). Insam competed in the 2012 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Italy men's national ice hockey team.
